paragraph: South Hackensack is one of the smallest markets in Bergen County, and the last six months show it. One single-family closing, a three-bedroom, two-bath ranch that sold for $750,000 against a $699,000 list price in nine days. That is a 1.07 sale-to-list ratio and a fast contract, but one sale is not a market read. It tells you a well-priced house in this town can move quickly and above asking. It cannot tell you where values are heading. There were no condo, townhouse, co-op, or multi-family closings at all. With a single May closing in the series, there is no monthly trend to read here, so the honest approach is to widen your search and track the surrounding towns for pricing context. If you're waiting on South Hackensack specifically, plan on patience and be ready to move fast when inventory does appear, because you may only get a few chances a year.
